const xs = [1, null, 2, undefined];
const ns: number[] = xs.filter((x) => x != null);
const strs = ["a", 1].filter((v) => typeof v === "string");
const s: string[] = strs;
function isPos(n: number) { return n > 0; }
const ps: number[] = [1, -1].filter(isPos);
const odd = [1, 2, 3].filter((n) => n % 2 === 1);
console.log(ns, s, ps, odd);
